_comment: faster-bag-tying config. Edit this file, then run apply.ps1 (it reverts to vanilla and re-patches automatically). apply.ps1 CLI flags override what's here.
_mode_notes: mode = 'multiplier' uses 'multiplier' on the vanilla tying times 1.0/1.35/1.7/1.8s; mode = 'seconds' uses the four explicit 'seconds' values below.
_alsoEmptying_notes: when true, emptyingDuration (dumping, vanilla 0.8/1.1/1.4/1.5s) is scaled by the same per-bag ratio.
